scope: Independent read-only correctness verification of completed 2021 RAISIN rounded-input endpoint and corner native fits; no native execution or population inference
source: astra_design/raisin_timing_assets/rounding_2021 frozen endpoint/corner case ledgers, their raw DAT/FITRES/log outputs, instrumentation_2021 absent baseline
parser: Independently parse CSP_ROW,CSP_OBJECTIVE,CSP_WROW/CSP_WDIAG by CID+iteration from raw logs, plus FITRES VARNAMES/SN rows and source DAT VARLIST/OBS. Do not import Astra runner/parser or states.npz.

gates.delta_dataQ_abs: max(0.01,0.001*archived2021 baseline dataQ) per original CID
gates.clone: all non-CID FITRES and full log-state science exactly equal to corresponding absent state

row_gate: Native final accepted (MJD,band,flux,error) multiset matches each source DAT's declared physical rows after source R4 flux/error; compare all source DAT changes to exact case-ledger declarations and original baseline DAT. Preserve duplicates.
timestamp_gate: For all32 MJD coordinates, enumerate nearby IEEE754 float32 states with libc snprintf %.3f equal to source printed token. Require the singleton and inverse open midpoint cell limits, via float64 nextafter, exactly match precision-ledger; no additional half-decimal allowance.
report: All 288 endpoint/corner cases and all failures in machine-readable ledger; per-stage summary, independent comparison to Astra output only after primary independent calculations. If outputs missing, record incomplete rather than infer pass.
